3d03941527d9dd41.description: About the Role AECOM is seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Inspector – Security and ICT to join our team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves conducting comprehensive security and ICT inspections, assessments, and audits to ensure organizational compliance with security standards and regulatory requirements. The Inspector will play a critical role in identifying vulnerabilities, mitigating risks, and maintaining the integrity of the security and technology infrastructure. Key Responsibilities Conduct regular security and ICT inspections across organizational facilities and systems to identify potential vulnerabilities and compliance gaps. Perform detailed risk assessments and analyze security threats to develop actionable recommendations for remediation. Evaluate ICT infrastructure, network systems, and security protocols against industry standards and organizational policies. Document inspection findings, observations, and recommendations in comprehensive reports with clear, professional communication. Verify compliance with security regulations, data protection frameworks, and internal security policies. Collaborate with IT and security teams to implement corrective actions and monitor their effectiveness. Investigate security incidents and breaches to determine root causes and prevent future occurrences. Maintain detailed records of all inspections, audits, and follow-up activities for audit trail purposes. Stay current with evolving security threats, ICT trends, and regulatory requirements to ensure inspections remain relevant and effective. Provide guidance and recommendations to management on security improvements and risk mitigation strategies. Required Qualifications and Experience Proven 8 years of experience conducting security audits, inspections, and assessments in corporate environments. Strong knowledge of ICT infrastructure, network systems, and security architecture. Demonstrated expertise in risk assessment, vulnerability analysis, and threat identification. Solid understanding of security compliance frameworks, regulatory requirements, and industry standards. Proficiency in analyzing security protocols, access controls, and data protection measures. Excellent organizational and documentation skills with the ability to prepare detailed technical reports. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with attention to detail. Effective communication skills to present findings and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Ability to work independently and manage multiple inspection projects simultaneously. Preferred Qualifications Security certifications such as ISO 27001, CISSP, or equivalent industry-recognized credentials. Experience with vulnerability assessment tools and security testing methodologies. Knowledge of incident response procedures and business continuity planning. Project management experience in security-related initiatives. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, requiring 8-10 years of experience. The role demands a proactive approach to security and ICT compliance within a corporate environment.

3d82379791e7f01c.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة أبراج العاليات للمقاولات عن فني كهروميكانيك للانضمام إلى فريقها في تبوك. يركز هذا الدور على تركيب ومراقبة الأنظمة والمعدات الكهروميكانيكية، بالإضافة إلى تقديم الدعم الفني لمهندسي الميكانيك في أنشطة البحث والتطوير. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تحديد المخططات ونوع وكمية المواد والمعدات واليد العاملة المطلوبة بناءً على المخططات الهندسية. توجيه وتنسيق جهود العمال والميكانيكيين وغيرهم من الحرفيين في عمليات تركيب الأنظمة الكهروميكانيكية. اختبار الأنظمة الكهروميكانيكية بعد تركيبها، والتأكد من مطابقتها للمخططات والمواصفات الفنية. تنفيذ عمليات الفحص الروتينية للصيانة الوقائية، وتشخيص التلفيات والأعطال المحتملة، واتخاذ الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة. تقديم المساعدة التقنية للمهندسين في أنشطة البحث والتطوير المتعلقة بالمعدات الكهروميكانيكية. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الكهروميكانيك. القدرة على قراءة وتفسير المخططات الهندسية والمواصفات الفنية. معرفة قوية بتركيب واختبار وصيانة الأنظمة والمعدات الكهروميكانيكية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات ممتازة في حل المشكلات وتشخيص الأعطال. القدرة على العمل بشكل مستقل وكجزء من فريق. مهارات تواصل فعالة لتقديم الدعم الفني والتنسيق مع الزملاء. بيئة العمل يعمل فني الكهروميكانيك بدوام كامل في مدينة تبوك، ضمن بيئة عمل ديناميكية تتطلب الدقة والالتزام بمعايير السلامة والجودة. معلومات إضافية هذه فرصة للانضمام إلى شركة رائدة في مجال المقاولات والمساهمة في مشاريعها المتنوعة. الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

3dcc7ab2b6fcaed8.description: About the Role Ninja (quick-commerce) is seeking an Outbound Team Leader to manage daily outbound warehouse operations in Jeddah, Makkah Province. This full-time role involves supervising the outbound team, ensuring accurate and timely processing, picking, packing, and dispatch of orders, and maintaining operational efficiency to meet daily targets. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Supervise and coordinate daily outbound warehouse activities. Ensure orders are picked, packed, sorted, and dispatched accurately and on schedule. Assign daily tasks and monitor team productivity and performance. Ensure outbound operations meet daily targets and operational KPIs. Monitor order accuracy and minimize picking and dispatch errors. Coordinate with inbound, inventory, and other warehouse teams to ensure smooth operations. Identify operational challenges and implement corrective actions. Ensure compliance with warehouse safety standards and operational procedures. Prepare daily performance reports and highlight operational issues. Support team training, development, and continuous improvement. Qualifications and Experience Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Logistics, Supply Chain Management, or a related field. Minimum of 2–3 years of experience in warehouse operations, with a preference for outbound operations. Previous experience in a supervisory or team leadership role. Required Skills Good understanding of picking, packing, sorting, and dispatch processes. Strong knowledge of warehouse operations and inventory handling. Ability to monitor KPIs and achieve operational targets. Strong leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills. Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment. Good organizational and time management skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Office; experience with warehouse management systems (WMS) is an advantage. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Jeddah, requiring active involvement in daily warehouse operations to ensure efficiency and target achievement. Application Process Candidates who meet the above requirements are encouraged to apply.

3deb11faabd8efc9.description: نبذة عن الدور تعلن شركة البيوت العصرية للمقاولات عن حاجتها لموظف صندوق محاسبة للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور على إدارة المعاملات النقدية والائتمانية بدقة، وضمان تسوية الحسابات اليومية، وتقديم خدمة عملاء ممتازة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية عد وتسجيل المبالغ المالية في آلة تسجيل النقود في بداية وردية العمل، والتأكد من توفر كمية كافية من العملات الصغيرة. استلام المدفوعات نقداً أو عن طريق بطاقة الائتمان أو أي طرق دفع أخرى معتمدة، ودفع المبالغ المتبقية، وتحرير الإيصالات المناسبة. تحديث قوائم الأسعار بشكل مستمر، وحساب أسعار السلع أو الخدمات، وإعداد جداول الفواتير، وتطبيق الخصومات عند اللزوم. تسوية النقدية الواردة مع إجمالي المبيعات في نهاية الوردية، والإبلاغ عن أي اختلافات أو تسويتها. التعامل مع العملاء بأسلوب مهني وترحيب، وتلبية طلباتهم المتعلقة بإضافة أو حذف عناصر من قوائم الشراء. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على التعامل مع المعاملات النقدية والائتمانية بدقة. مهارات جيدة في التعامل مع العملاء. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويقع في المدينة المنورة، المملكة العربية السعودية. يتطلب العمل الالتزام بمواعيد الوردية المحددة والتعاون مع فريق العمل لضمان سير العمليات بسلاسة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة خلال عملية التوظيف. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور في شركة البيوت العصرية للمقاولات.

3dfa78db6c1b2f59.description: About the Role Al-Enjaz Company is seeking a Traffic Engineer to join its Engineering Projects / Roads and Transport Department. This full-time position is based in Al Lith, Makkah, and requires a Saudi national with 5-10 years of experience in traffic and road safety engineering. Job Purpose The primary objective of this role is to plan, implement, and monitor traffic and road safety engineering standards within road and infrastructure projects. The Traffic Engineer will ensure adherence to specifications approved by the Ministry of Municipal and Rural Affairs and Housing (or Ministry of Transport and Logistics Services) and local municipalities. Key responsibilities include preparing and reviewing Traffic Management Plans (TMPs) and Traffic Impact Assessments (TIAs) to ensure smooth and safe traffic flow during and after project implementation. Key Responsibilities Traffic Management Plan (TMP) Development and Approval: Design, review, and approve traffic diversion and safety plans for work sites, ensuring compliance with approved guidelines from municipalities/ministries and the General Directorate of Traffic. Work Zone Safety Management: Conduct field supervision of work zone setups, including warning signs, directional signs, concrete and rubber barriers, road markings, and flashing lights, ensuring their regular maintenance. Regular Inspection and Auditing: Perform field visits and Road Safety Audits, documenting observations and violations, and ensuring immediate corrective actions by contractors/implementation teams. Accident and Risk Analysis: Conduct technical investigations of traffic accidents within the work scope or road right-of-way, analyze their causes, and propose engineering solutions to prevent recurrence. Reporting: Submit periodic and technical reports on performance levels, traffic safety, and the progress of diversions and permits to project management and the client. Qualifications and Requirements Educational Qualification: Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering or Transportation and Traffic Engineering from a recognized university. Professional Accreditation: Valid registration and accreditation with the Saudi Council of Engineers (Professional or Associate Engineer level). Valid accreditation as an approved engineer with a municipality or ministry (Regional Municipality, Ministry of Municipal and Rural Affairs and Housing, or Ministry of Transport). Work Experience: A minimum of 5 years of experience in traffic and road safety engineering. Proven practical experience in projects for municipalities, or the Ministry of Transport. Work Environment This is a full-time position within the Engineering Projects / Roads and Transport Department, located in Al Lith, Makkah. The role involves working on significant road and infrastructure projects, ensuring compliance with national and local safety standards. Application Process Qualified candidates are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

3d0056a704d6c094.description: About the Role Acxiom - MENA is seeking an Associate Director SEO to lead its SEO practice in the MENA region. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and involves managing a team focused on delivering organic search performance for high-profile clients. The role requires accountability for client outcomes, delivery quality, and revenue, bridging client leadership, technical SEO, and commercial management. Key Responsibilities Own end-to-end delivery of SEO programs for key clients, including strategy, scope, timelines, budget, and KPI reporting. Act as a senior SEO adviser to clients, presenting performance and recommendations to client leadership, justifying spend and return. Coordinate specialist teams (analytics, content, development, outreach) to meet client KPIs and position SEO within the paid, owned, and earned media mix. Manage revenue and margin for the SEO portfolio, working with finance on forecasts and revenue realization, and designing profitable scopes. Grow existing accounts through proactive management and upsell, safeguarding retainer spend with clear performance reporting. Lead SEO input for new business RFPs and pitches, collaborating with sales and agency partners to build pipeline. Evolve the SEO offering, including eCommerce SEO and visibility in AI search, and develop reusable products such as audit frameworks and reporting dashboards. Publish points of view, case studies, and represent Acxiom at conferences and client events. Hire, coach, and develop the team, setting goals, conducting 1:1s and appraisals, and building development plans. Manage the weekly team WIP, ensure quality of team output, and report weekly on project and business status to the Regional Director. Manage SEO tools and vendors for value, coordinating with Acxiom global offices and rolling out global initiatives in the region. Qualifications and Experience 8+ years of experience in SEO or organic search at an agency, in-house, or consultancy, including 3+ years leading teams. Demonstrated track record of retaining and growing high-profile client relationships with significant ongoing SEO billings. Deep expertise in technical SEO, content and on-page optimization, and authority building (digital PR, outreach), with working knowledge of SMO. Commercial skills including forecasting, profitable scoping, and managing delivery against budget. Experience in eCommerce SEO and driving organic visibility from shopper interest. Experience justifying SEO investment to direct-response clients with clear, ongoing reporting. Hands-on proficiency with Google Search Console, GA4, Semrush or Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, and Looker Studio. Strong project management skills and confidence in presenting to senior client stakeholders. Active presence in the SEO community through speaking engagements, published thought leadership, or professional memberships. Preferred Qualifications Experience optimizing for generative and AI search (GEO / AI Overviews). Bilingual English-Arabic SEO and multi-market GCC experience across sectors such as retail, telco, real estate, automotive, or luxury. Experience combining SEO with first-party data, audience insights, or customer data platforms. Track record of awards, case studies, or award shortlists in search. Bachelor's degree in marketing, business, or a related field. Work Type This is a full-time position requiring 5-10 years of experience. Location The role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

3d199fb8024fa0c5.description: About the Role Alfanar Projects is seeking a ServiceNow SPM Sr. Technical Consultant to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time role is responsible for developing, implementing, and improving Service Portfolio Management (SPM) solutions within ServiceNow. The consultant will optimize PPM, Demand Management, APM, and Resource Management to align with business objectives, ensuring value and governance. Key Responsibilities Assist in the development, configuration, and administration of various ServiceNow SPM modules. Support integration activities between ServiceNow SPM and other enterprise systems, utilizing REST, SOAP APIs, and Integration Hub for seamless data exchange. Implement best practices for Service Portfolio Management, including optimizing workflows, automating processes, and establishing governance frameworks within ServiceNow. Participate in requirement gathering sessions and stakeholder workshops, performing functional analysis to align business needs with portfolio management capabilities. Configure applications, business rules, workflows, and automation scripts using ServiceNow’s scripting languages (JavaScript, Glide, and Business Rules). Assist in testing, deployment, and change management for new SPM-related implementations, ensuring they meet functional, financial, and strategic requirements. Troubleshoot and resolve technical and functional issues related to portfolio management processes, dashboards, and integrations. Maintain comprehensive documentation for SPM configurations, customizations, integrations, and governance structures, ensuring compliance with security, access control policies, and data governance. Stay updated with ServiceNow SPM enhancements, industry trends, and best practices, recommending continuous improvements and innovative solutions. Perform planned activities to meet operational and development targets as per delivery schedules, utilizing resources effectively within efficient cost and time. Provide periodic reports detailing deviations and execution of planned tasks. Solve arising problems and escalate complex operational issues. Ensure quality requirements to develop effective quality control and processes, including specifications for products or related activities. Coordinate well-defined written systems, policies, procedures, and seek automation opportunities. Comply with related policies, procedures, and work instructions. Ensure compliance with relevant safety, quality, and environmental management procedures and controls within the defined area of work activity. Qualifications and Experience 6-10 years of relevant experience. Work Type This is a full-time position. Application Information Salary for this position will be disclosed during the interview process.

3d5f9d741fa5edd9.description: About the Role Cisco is seeking an Account Executive - Portfolio - Service Provider to join its sales organization in Riyadh. This full-time role focuses on accelerating digital transformation for high-profile Service Provider, Enterprise, and Commercial accounts within the Saudi Arabian market. Analyze CRM data and sales performance trends to create accurate forecasts and weekly commitments that support regional business planning. 3dba4c8bc03d0c1a.description: About the Role Pepsico is seeking a Digital Analyst to join its Consumer Engagement team. This full-time role involves managing consumer engagement initiatives for iconic brands such as Lay's, Doritos, Cheetos, Pepsi, 7UP, Mirinda, and Sting in Saudi Arabia. The successful candidate will serve as a key liaison between KSA brand teams and the regional Consumer Engagement team, ensuring that campaigns resonate with the Saudi consumer base. Role Context and Impact This position is a dual role, functioning as the primary contact for the Consumer Engagement team within the KSA office and as the custodian of PepsiCo's brand voice in the Saudi market. The Digital Analyst will collaborate closely with Snacks and Beverages brand teams to translate their objectives into effective consumer campaigns. This role requires a professional who can ensure that all consumer communications, including push notifications, in-app messages, emails, and replies, reflect a distinctly Saudi tone and personality. Key Responsibilities Act as the primary liaison between KSA Snacks and Beverages brand teams and the Cairo-based Consumer Engagement team, converting brand priorities into clear briefs, campaigns, and channel plans. Plan and execute brand campaigns end-to-end, including brainstorming, concept shaping, partner briefing, launch, and results reporting. Contribute consumer engagement input to the KSA brand team's Annual Operating Plan, E-commerce and Away-from-Home plans, and quarterly brand reviews. Support consumer engagement media planning with the media team and agency partners, and manage influencer collaborations. Own the language and tone of consumer engagement in KSA across all touchpoints, maintaining tone-of-voice guidance and a comprehensive Arabic and English glossary. Write and adapt Arabic-first copy (and English where necessary) that is culturally relevant and engaging for Saudi consumers. Review content from the team and agencies prior to publication. Plan creative work, brief designers and agencies, and review output against brand standards. Consolidate the quarterly content calendar across brands and channels, including engagement and educational CRM notifications. Manage push, in-app, and email content within Salesforce Marketing Cloud, including building, testing, scheduling, and launching. Monitor campaign performance and translate results into actionable optimization ideas for brands. Test app updates, enhancements, and new features, and raise IT tickets for necessary fixes. Manage relationships with loyalty aggregators, reward partners, and direct Saudi partners to source valuable consumer rewards. Handle purchase orders, quotes, invoice payments, and goods receipts, coordinating across Snacks and Beverages. Track budgets to ensure campaigns adhere to financial plans. Own and regularly update complaint-handling templates, consolidate consumer complaints, and raise IT tickets as needed. Manage app store reviews and replies to address consumer feedback. Handle COC-related matters for KSA campaigns and partners. Hire, train, and coach one to two trainees in KSA, supporting their development in marketing. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of experience in consumer engagement, CRM, or brand marketing. Demonstrated ability in crafting effective Arabic copy. Experience in managing campaigns end-to-end. Proficiency in CRM platforms, particularly Salesforce Marketing Cloud. Skills and Attributes Strong creative writing skills. Ability to manage multiple tasks including CRM, partnerships, and analytics. Effective communication and interpersonal skills for cross-functional collaboration. Detail-oriented with strong organizational abilities. Career Development This role offers significant ownership and the opportunity to advise senior brand managers directly. It provides exposure to both KSA brand teams and a regional digital team, fostering a broad network and visibility within PepsiCo. The position is a natural progression towards larger consumer engagement and CRM responsibilities within the company.

Working at the intersection of engineering, commercial oversight, and project delivery, the team helps bring complex civil engineering programs from planning through execution with strong governance and contractual discipline. Partner with project management teams on contract administration matters across the project lifecycle. Interface with clients on contractual issues and related commercial discussions. Strong background in contract administration with project management exposure. Experience administering contracts under FIDIC frameworks. Experience interfacing with clients on contract-related matters. Experience administering contracts in the SAR 5 billion+ range is a plus. Experience working in Saudi Arabia is preferred.

The Product Manager will develop pricing models, analyze market trends, and collaborate with sales and operations teams to establish pricing strategies that align with the company's financial and business objectives. 3da1a68416a85a3b.description: About the Role Egis is seeking an experienced Mechanical Design Lead to join its engineering team in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. The successful candidate will work within a dynamic engineering team, collaborating across multiple disciplines on significant airport infrastructure projects. 3daec6ab1ae9c8eb.description: About Qiddiya Qiddiya is seeking a Senior Legal Counsel Land and RE transactions to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves providing comprehensive legal support for land and real estate transactions within the Qiddiya project. The role requires extensive experience in real estate and hospitality law, ensuring legal risks are identified and managed effectively across various project phases. Draft, review, negotiate, and finalize real estate agreements, including sale, lease, development, off-plan sales, and leasing documentation. Liaise with REGA and other relevant regulatory authorities, including matters involving the Ejar platform and Wafi program. Draft and negotiate documentation for hotel and branded residence developments, including letters of intent, term sheets, technical services agreements, brand licensing agreements, and hotel management arrangements. Provide legal support for facilities management, property management, estate management, and asset management arrangements. Advise on master community and estate governance frameworks, including community charters, owners' associations, and estate management structures. Coordinate with relevant legal and business subject-matter experts on matters involving tax, insurance, finance, intellectual property, data protection, cybersecurity, local content, environmental, and sustainability considerations. Demonstrated expertise in real estate law, land development, and regulatory compliance. Experience with hospitality developments and related legal documentation is essential. 3da9e33a31e58ae3.description: About the Role Silqfi is seeking a Credit Analyst to join our team in Dammam, Eastern Province. This full-time role involves assessing SME credit applications across various products, identifying key credit risks, and preparing clear recommendations aligned with credit policy and risk appetite. The Credit Analyst will manage the full credit file, from analysis to memo and recommendation, and contribute to improving underwriting processes through automation and system enhancements. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Handle SME credit applications end-to-end, from screening and evaluation to credit decision recommendations, including supply chain and invoice-backed financing in line with credit policy. Analyze financial statements, bank statements, VAT returns, management accounts, SIMAH reports, and supporting documents. Evaluate business performance, cash flow, indebtedness, existing obligations, repayment capacity, and overall creditworthiness. Review invoices, contracts, purchase orders, receivables, and buyer information supporting credit requests. Conduct customer calls to clarify business activity, cash flows, and information gaps. Identify credit, fraud, concentration, and transaction risks, including related-party activity, unusual transactions, and inconsistencies in submitted information. Prepare complete credit memos with clear recommendations on limits, tenors, repayment structures, and risk mitigants. Collaborate with Sales, Operations, and Collections to complete assessments within agreed turnaround times. Maintain accurate assessments and records in the loan origination system. Support the testing and rollout of system features, automated checks, and underwriting workflows. Suggest improvements to reduce manual work and strengthen assessment quality. Adapt to evolving policies, tools, and business priorities while maintaining sound credit judgment. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Banking, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field. Previous experience in Saudi Arabia, with a good understanding of the Saudi lending ecosystem. Hands-on experience analyzing bank statements and financial statements to assess creditworthiness. Professional proficiency in Arabic and English (written and spoken). Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, clear credit writing, and advanced Excel. Ability to manage multiple applications in a fast-paced environment. 3d8f010f9a148447.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة نجم الأجهزة للتجارة عن مدير تطوير موارد بشرية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يشارك شاغل هذا الدور في وضع الأهداف الرئيسية والخطط والبرامج المتعلقة كامل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تطوير الأهداف الرئيسية المتعلقة بإدارة تطوير الموارد البشرية، وتطوير وتطبيق الخطط والبرامج والمشروعات، والتأكد من وجود الأطر والمقاييس الدقيقة لمعرفة مستوى تحقيق هذه الخطط والأهداف. تطوير الخطط والبرامج والمشروعات التفصيلية المتعلقة بتطوير الموارد البشرية، بما يشمل إدارة الأداء وتدريب وتطوير المواهب وبرامج المسارات الوظيفية وبرامج الإحلال والتعاقب الوظيفي، ومتابعة عملية تنفيذها لضمان أفضل المخرجات والنتائج. الإشراف على تطبيق نظام إدارة الأداء في الجهة بجميع مراحله، وتوجيه وإدارة عملية تحديد الاحتياجات التدريبية للموظفين وإعداد خطط التدريب السنوية، وضمان تحديد أساليب التدريب والتعلم المناسبة بصورة فعالة، وضمان فعاليتها بالتنسيق مع مدراء الوحدات التنظيمية. تحديد احتياجات إدارة تطوير الموارد البشرية من الموارد المالية والبشرية والمستلزمات الإدارية اللازمة لتنفيذ عمليات تطوير الموارد البشرية المختلفة، بما يكفل سد احتياجات الجهة من المواهب الحالية والمستقبلية. الإشراف على عمليات إعداد وتحضير الملخصات والتقارير العامة المتعلقة بعمليات تطوير الموارد البشرية، وعرضها على الإدارة العليا، وإحاطتها بمختلف التحديات والمستجدات، واستشارتهم في مختلف القضايا والمبادرات المستقبلية المهمة. تخطيط وتطوير الموارد البشرية يتولى المدير مسؤولية تنظيم أعمال تطوير الموارد البشرية ومتابعة كافة الأعمال المعدة في هذا السياق. يشمل ذلك ضمان توافر كافة الموارد التقنية والبشرية التي تضمن سير العمليات بأكبر كفاءة وفعالية ممكنة، مع التركيز على بناء أطر الجدارات وتخطيط المسارات الوظيفية. إدارة الأداء والتدريب يشرف هذا الدور على كافة جوانب إدارة الأداء، بدءاً من تحديد الاحتياجات التدريبية وصولاً إلى إعداد الخطط السنوية للتدريب. يضمن المدير اختيار أساليب التدريب والتعلم الفعالة، ويعمل على تقييم فعاليتها بالتنسيق مع مدراء الوحدات التنظيمية لضمان تحقيق أقصى استفادة للموظفين والشركة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال تطوير الموارد البشرية أو دور مشابه. فهم عميق لمفاهيم إدارة الأداء، التدريب والتطوير، أطر الجدارات، وتخطيط المسارات الوظيفية. القدرة على تطوير وتطبيق الخطط والبرامج والمشروعات المتعلقة بالموارد البشرية. مهارات الشركة.

What You Will Deliver Asset Ramp-up & Performance Shape and embed an enterprise approach to asset ramp-up that shortens the path from commissioning to stable operations across mining and processing assets. Identify and activate the critical throughput, recovery, uptime, cost and readiness levers that accelerate early-stage asset performance. Diagnose systemic ramp-up constraints and enable focused interventions that address root causes and protect production value. Value Realization Translate ramp-up opportunities into measurable value hypotheses, performance targets and interventions with clear ownership and benefit tracking. Drive sustained improvements in ramp-up speed, asset utilization and operational readiness through fact-based performance management. Provide actionable insights that enable leadership to prioritize interventions and investments against the areas of greatest operational value. Digital & Analytics Enablement Accelerate the application of advanced analytics, digital twins and predictive capabilities where they improve commissioning, stabilization and ramp-up decisions. Embed relevant digital capabilities into operational workflows to strengthen real-time visibility, decision quality and performance management. Enable repeatable ramp-up use cases to scale across assets in partnership with technology, data and solution teams. Enterprise Execution & Governance Orchestrate alignment across Operations, Technology & Innovation, Data & AI, projects and commissioning stakeholders to resolve cross-functional dependencies and barriers. Establish consistent governance, performance measures and executive-level visibility across priority ramp-up initiatives. Strengthen the transition between project, commissioning and operational teams through clear performance expectations and integrated execution. Standards & Organizational Capability Develop and embed scalable ramp-up playbooks, tools and practices appropriate to different asset classes and operating environments. Convert lessons from asset ramp-ups into reusable organizational knowledge that improves subsequent commissioning and stabilization. Build organizational capability through technical coaching, knowledge transfer and adoption of proven ramp-up practices. What Success Looks Like Reduced time from commissioning to stable and targeted operating performance. Improved throughput, recovery, uptime and asset utilization during ramp-up. Measurable value realized from prioritized digital, analytics and operational interventions. Reduced recurrence of ramp-up constraints through effective root-cause resolution and reuse of lessons learned. Increased adoption of standardized ramp-up methods, playbooks and proven use cases across applicable assets. Stronger visibility of ramp-up performance, risks and value realization to enable faster management decisions. Desired Candidate Profile Bachelor s degree in Engineering, Mining, Metallurgy, Industrial Engineering or a related discipline. Master s degree in a relevant discipline is advantageous. 12 15+ years of relevant experience in mining, mineral processing or comparable heavy industry environments. Significant exposure to asset commissioning, operational ramp-up, stabilization and performance improvement. Experience delivering operational value through digital, analytics or technology-enabled improvement initiatives. Experience working across multidisciplinary operational, technical, project and technology stakeholders. Asset ramp-up and commissioning optimization Mining and processing operational excellence Production performance and bottleneck analysis Advanced analytics and digital enablement Value realization and benefits management Performance management and KPI design Strategic problem-solving Cross-functional execution Senior stakeholder influencing Change and capability building

3d2734ad33aa1217.description: Job description About Noon Noon is a Saudi EdTech company. Noon Track runs inside schools: a hybrid programme that prepares students for Qudrat ( قدرات ) and Tahsili ( تحصيلي ), the national university-admission exams. Our students are 15 to 17 years old. Noon is becoming an AI-native company, department by department, and the number of schools we serve is growing. We believe every student deserves world-class teachers. And to make it happen, we’re reimagining everything about education: from cutting-edge tech to peer learning and physical spaces that spark curiosity. Hear about our vision directly from our CEO here. Learn more about us [ here] The role You will be the one designer who owns the student experience. Primarily that means the student app: where students study, work with an AI tutor, answer questions, and take part in activities, including games and head-to-head duels on a topic. You will also shape parts of the live classroom experience. This is a Senior/Principal-level individual contributor Product Designer role. There is no design team underneath you and no manager drawing your roadmap. You take a problem from the first student conversation to the shipped screen, and you decide what to look at next. Why this role One owner of the whole student experience, with a direct line to leadership. Speed: with AI in the workflow, ideas go from research to release in days, not quarters. An experimentation practice being built from the ground up, with you shaping it. A company expanding into more schools, with a long-term ambition to match. What you will do Spend real time with students in Saudi schools. Interviews, focus groups, classroom observation. Turn what you hear into design decisions, and go back to check them. Design for Saudi Arabia, not for the generic 'best practice' app. Patterns that work in London or San Francisco often fail here. You know why, and you can show it in your work. Own the student app end to end. Flows, information architecture, prototypes, final UI, and the handover to engineering. Design activities students want to come back to, games and duels included, with learning as the gate: an activity that is more fun but teaches less is a regression. Run experiments. State a hypothesis, build the variants, agree the metric, and read the result honestly. You will help build the experimentation practice, not just use it. Work AI-native. Use AI tools for generation, prototyping and production so your time goes to research and judgement. We care about the quality of your decisions, not how many pixels you pushed by hand. Work directly with the product manager and engineers. Short loops, fast releases, no layers. About you (To be successful in this role, you should have): Roughly 5 years of experience in UX, product design experience. We care less about the number and more about how many people you have interviewed and what you did with it. A research practice you can describe in detail: how you recruit, what you ask, how you synthesise, how it reached the product. A portfolio of projects that demonstrate your creativity and delivery of results through great consumer-facing mobile-first experiences Proficiency in using various tools and techniques to create and communicate your design ideas, such as sketches, wireframes, mockups, prototypes, etc. Experience in conducting user research and testing in different contexts and cultures, using both qualitative and quantitative methods A strong sense of empathy, curiosity, and creativity, and a willingness to learn and experiment Why Noon? Real impact — your work directly affects how thousands of students learn every day. Speed and autonomy — small team, big problems, zero bureaucracy. AI-native culture — we don't just talk about AI, we build with it daily. Well-funded — Series B closed, substantial recurring revenue, and accelerating. Mission that matters — every student deserves world-class teachers. We're making it happen. Benefits In addition to a competitive base salary, we offer: Performance-based bonus 21 days of annual leave Full premium Medical coverage, including Family Dependent Preferred candidate Years of experience No experience required Degree Bachelor's degree / higher diploma

3d6d959d765bc754.description: Job Description The Registrar Nephrology is a physician in specialty training who delivers comprehensive nephrology care exclusively through virtual platforms. The role focuses on the assessment, diagnosis, and management of acute and chronic kidney diseases using telehealth technologies, ensuring safe, evidence-based, and patient-centred care under consultant supervision, while supporting continuity of care and chronic disease management Virtual Patient Consultations and clinical Management:  Conduct video and phone consultations for patients with nephrology-related conditions.  Assess and manage chronic kidney disease (CKD), hypertension, electrolyte disorders, proteinuria, haematuria, nephrolithiasis, and post-AKI follow-up.  Review laboratory results and imaging remotely and adjust management plans accordingly.  Identify red flags requiring urgent in-person assessment or hospital referral.  Develop individualized treatment and monitoring plans in collaboration with consultants.  Ensure accurate and timely documentation in the electronic medical record (EMR).  Arrange virtual follow-ups and coordinate care with primary providers. Chronic Disease Management and Continuity of Care:  Monitor CKD progression using laboratory trends and patient-reported outcomes.  Provide virtual counselling on lifestyle modification, diet, fluid balance, and medication adherence.  Support anaemia of CKD, CKD-MBD, and blood pressure management remotely.  Collaborate with dietitians and allied health professionals via telehealth platforms.  Coordinate dialysis preparation education and timely referrals when indicated. Quality Assurance, Patient Safety, and Compliance:  Adhere to nephrology clinical guidelines, telemedicine regulations, and ethical standards.  Ensure safe prescribing practices, including dose adjustments in renal impairment.  Monitor and counsel patients regarding medication side effects and warning signs.  Report patient safety concerns and adverse events to the Quality Department.  Participate in virtual audits, quality improvement initiatives, and clinical reviews. Telehealth Platform Proficiency and Digital Care Delivery:  Utilize telemedicine platforms for video consultations, secure messaging, and lab result reviews.  Maintain accurate, complete, and confidential digital patient records.  Optimize use of remote monitoring data (e.g. home blood pressure readings).  Participate in telehealth training and collaborate with IT support for system optimization Patient Experience and Satisfaction:  Communicate diagnoses and management plans clearly and empathetically.  Provide education on kidney disease progression, treatment options, and red-flag symptoms.  Address patient concerns and follow-up questions promptly via telehealth channels.  Encourage adherence to treatment plans and follow-up schedules Multidisciplinary and Consultant Collaboration:  Collaborate virtually with nephrology consultants for case discussions and escalation of care.  Coordinate care with primary care physicians, nurses, pharmacists, and dietitians.  Participate in multidisciplinary virtual meetings and care planning. Professional Development and Teaching:  Maintain up-to-date knowledge in nephrology.  Attend CME, workshops and conferences.  Participate in case discussion and academic activity.  Support teaching and supervision of junior doctors when required. Skills Medical degree (MBBS or equivalent) from an accredited institution. Completion of Internal Medicine residency from an accredited program. Nephrology training/fellowship (in progress or completed). Saudi Commission for Health Specialties (SCFHS) classification and registration as Registrar Nephrology. Strong clinical judgment with expertise in CKD and renal pharmacology. Experience or strong interest in telemedicine-based care. Proficiency in EMR systems and telehealth platforms. Excellent communication, analytical, and organizational skills. Commitment to patient safety, quality improvement, and continuous professional development. Education Medicine & Surgery

3d4591d0057d20ba.description: Job Overview: The E-commerce Operations Senior Specialist is responsible for the end-to-end daily operation of Al Ahli’s online store on Salla. This role owns order monitoring, fulfilment coordination with the warehouse, returns and exchanges, and product master data, acting as the key link between the Commercial, Marketing, IT, and warehouse teams. 3db1582614768cb3.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة سراكو عن مدير أشغال ومرافق عامة للانضمام إلى فريقها في جازان. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية تخطيط وتوجيه وتنسيق أنشطة إدارة المرافق في المنشأة، بما في ذلك الجداول الزمنية لأعمال الصيانة والتنظيف للمواقع المادية الحالية والمستقبلية، بالإضافة إلى التصاميم والأثاث. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات. المسؤوليات الرئيسية وضع الخطط والسياسات والاستراتيجيات الإدارية العامة لمرافق الشركة، والإشراف على تنفيذها. ضمان الالتزام بقواعد ولوائح الصحة والسلامة والبيئة، والإشراف على تطبيقها. الإشراف على الأنشطة اليومية للمرافق في المنشأة، بما في ذلك المواقع المادية والتصاميم والأثاث. تخطيط الجداول الزمنية لأعمال الصيانة والتنظيف للمرافق. الإشراف على أنشطة الصيانة وتنسيق عمليات التصليح مع تقليل مدة التوقف عن العمل. اختيار الموظفين وتدريبهم والإشراف عليهم، ومراقبة أدائهم وسلوكهم مقارنةً بالأهداف المحددة. تخطيط أعمال الإنشاء والملحقات الجديدة. إعداد ومراجعة والموافقة على العقود المتعلقة بالبناء. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في إدارة المرافق أو مجال ذي صلة. فهم قوي لمبادئ إدارة المرافق والصيانة. القدرة على تخطيط وتنسيق الجداول الزمنية والعمليات التشغيلية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات قيادية وإشرافية قوية. مهارات ممتازة في التخطيط والتنظيم. القدرة على اتخاذ القرارات وحل المشكلات بفعالية. مهارات تواصل ممتازة، شفهية وكتابية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويقع في مدينة جازان. سيعمل مدير الأشغال والمرافق العامة ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة سراكو، حيث يساهم في الحفاظ على كفاءة وسلامة مرافق الشركة. التقديم للمهتمين بالتقديم على هذا الدور، يرجى إرسال السيرة الذاتية. لم يتم الكشف عن تفاصيل الراتب في الوقت الحالي.

3d06dc5260037f1e.description: About the Role OSUS is seeking a Senior Contracts Engineer to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role serves as the primary contractual reference on the owner/developer side, focusing on the preparation and control of contract documents. The position requires a deep understanding of FIDIC and Saudi law, with a strong emphasis on reviewing variations, claims, and contractors' entitlements against contractual terms and applicable legal frameworks. This role specifically excludes pricing or cost estimating responsibilities. Key Responsibilities Maintain contract registers, document control, and backups for all contracts, both physical and digital. Coordinate effectively with project management, technical office, procurement, finance, and legal departments. Prepare periodic contracts status reports for the Contracts Manager. Contribute to the development of standard contract templates, policies, and procedures. Ensure strict compliance with Saudi regulations and the company's delegation of authority. Perform additional tasks as assigned by the line manager within the scope of work. Pre-Contract Administration Prepare and review contract documents, including the form of agreement, general and particular conditions, scope of work, specifications, and appendices, ensuring consistency and a clear order of precedence. Draft Particular Conditions to amend FIDIC, protecting company interests by covering risk allocation, time bars, delay damages, payment terms, guarantees, insurance, termination, and dispute resolution. Prepare contractual sections of tender documents and respond to bidders' contractual queries. Conduct contractual evaluation of bids, assessing deviations, exceptions, qualifications, and compliance with contract terms. Negotiate contractual terms with bidders, identify contractual risks, and propose mitigation strategies. Draft and finalize contracts, letters of award, purchase orders, and NDAs; verify bonds, guarantees, insurances, authorized signatories, and counterparty registrations before signature. Post-Contract Administration Administer awarded contracts and monitor all parties' obligations, notices, and time bars. Review contractors' entitlements in interim and final payment applications against the contract and applicable law, including retention, advance payment recovery, deductions, delay damages, and set-off. Quantities are verified by the project team. Review variations and change orders: determine validity, assess entitlement, and establish the contractual basis of valuation (FIDIC Clause 13); maintain the variations register. Assess contractor claims for time and cost under FIDIC Clause 20: evaluate notice compliance, contractual basis, and entitlement; draft responses and counter-claims. Support Engineer's determinations (FIDIC Clause * and dispute resolution through DAAB, arbitration, or courts. Prepare contractual correspondence, notices, warnings, and termination letters when required. Track bonds, guarantees, insurances, and retention, ensuring timely renewals before expiry. Manage contract close-out, including review of final account entitlements, release of retention and guarantees, final discharge, and lessons learned. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Civil or Architectural Engineering. 8–12 years of relevant experience, with at least 5 years specifically in contract administration or contracts management. Demonstrated experience with a real estate developer or owner organization. In-depth knowledge of FIDIC 1999 and 1987 (Red Book), particularly concerning variations, claims, determinations, payment, and termination. Advanced proficiency in Excel and MS Office Suite. Application Process Candidates meeting the above qualifications are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

3dc739548f6a79f2.description: Eram Talent, a leading talent acquisition company, is seeking a highly skilled Lead Master Data Management (MDM) Architect to join our team in Saudi Arabia. In this pivotal role, you will be responsible for defining and implementing robust MDM strategies and frameworks that ensure the quality, consistency, and accessibility of master data across various platforms and applications. The ideal candidate will possess extensive experience in master data management, data governance, and architecture. You will lead cross-functional teams in designing MDM solutions that align with business objectives while adhering to industry best practices. Additionally, you will work closely with stakeholders to understand their data needs and translate them into actionable strategies. If selected, the work location would be onsite at Saudi Arabia. Responsibilities Develop and maintain the Master Data Management strategy to meet business requirements and enhance data quality . Collaborate with business stakeholders, executives, and Technology departments to understand business requirements and translate them into Master Data Management architecture solutions. Lead the design and architecture of MDM solutions considering scalability, performance and integration with existing systems Define and enforce Master Data Management architectural standards, frameworks, and methodologies across the organization. Define data governance policies and standards to maintain the accuracy and reliability of master data. Provide expertise in data modelling, data profiling, data quality assessments and data models management Collaborate with Data Quality and MDM teams to provide architectural oversight, inputs on standards & mentorship Collaborate with stakeholders to understand data consumption patterns and optimize MDM solutions accordingly. Evaluate and recommend emerging technologies, tools, and platforms to enhance the company's MDM capabilities. Conduct the design, implementation, and maintenance of enterprise-wide Technology systems, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security and seek approval from the Master Data Quality Manager on the same. Conduct regular assessments and audits to ensure compliance with Technology architecture standards and identify areas for improvement. Drive the integration of new technologies and solutions, ensuring seamless interoperability with existing systems. Provide technical expertise and support while, conducting the planning and execution of Technology projects. Stay up-to-date with industry trends and advancements in MDM, proposing innovative solutions to enhance business operations. Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field. Certified Data Privacy Solutions Engineer (CDPSE) preferred 7+ years of experience in data management focused on Master Data Management. Strong background in data governance, data quality management, and data integration. Proven experience with MDM tools such as Informatica MDM, Talend, or SAP MDG. Demonstrated ability to design and implement MDM frameworks and processes that drive data quality improvements. Excellent communication, leadership, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with stakeholders at all levels. In-depth understanding of data architecture, data modeling, and related technologies. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a focus on delivering actionable solutions. Experience in guiding and mentoring teams in a collaborative environment. Fluency in English; proficiency in Arabic is a plus.

3d4e4ca7b15e899f.description: The Electrical Engineer supports the Senior MEP Engineer in managing the maintenance and performance of all medium and low-voltage power distribution systems within the Primary Nursery Facility at NEOM. This includes electrical substations, switchgear, distribution boards, emergency generators, UPS, lighting, and general power infrastructure. The role is responsible for supervising the execution of preventive, reactive and corrective maintenance activities carried out by the service provider, ensuring compliance with safety protocols, technical standards, and contractual KPIs. The Electrical Engineer supports maintenance planning, monitors spare parts consumption, oversees electrical testing and commissioning activities, and ensures system reliability and energy efficiency across the facility. Collaboration with other engineering disciplines, particularly the Low Current and Mechanical teams, is essential to maintaining safe and seamless MEP operations. Support the Senior MEP Engineer in maintaining MV/LV electrical systems, substations, generators, UPS, lighting, and power infrastructure. Monitor preventive, corrective, and reactive maintenance activities in line with approved plans and manufacturer guidelines. Supervise service providers to ensure safe, high-quality work and compliance with electrical safety standards. Assist in developing and improving electrical maintenance programs and schedules. Conduct inspections and audits to ensure system reliability, efficiency, and QA/QC compliance. Assess service provider performance and recommend training or improvements. Monitor spare parts usage and support inventory planning. Assist with asset condition assessments and planning for upgrades or replacements. Support preparation and review of technical documents and maintenance reports. Troubleshoot electrical faults and support root cause analysis. Assist with commissioning, handover, and closeout of electrical installations. Promote electrical safety and participate in HSE audits and corrective actions. Support energy efficiency initiatives and best maintenance practices. Assist in design reviews, decommissioning activities, and coordination with contractors and stakeholders. Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline (mandatory). 4–6 years of experience in electrical system design, operation, and maintenance, with good knowledge of applicable codes and standards. Strong understanding of MV/LV power distribution systems, substations, generators, UPS, and lighting systems. Experience in preventive and corrective maintenance planning and execution. Familiarity with electrical safety regulations, HSE practices, and QA/QC procedures. Ability to read, interpret, and review electrical drawings, schematics, and technical documents. Experience in supervising contractors or service providers. Basic knowledge of asset management systems and maintenance reporting.

3d94f1455dfd8b33.description: Eram Talent is excited to welcome motivated and ambitious fresh graduates from Engineering disciplines who are eager to begin their professional careers. We are looking for fresh graduates from a wide range of academic disciplines, including but not limited to Mechanical Engineer, Chemical Engineer, Electrical Engineer, Civil Engineer, Environmental Engineer. If you are passionate about building a meaningful career and contributing to impactful projects, we encourage you to apply. Bachelor’s degree in an Engineering field (Civil Engineer, Chemical Engineer, Electrical Engineer, Computer Engineer, Environmental Engineer, Safety Engineer, Instrumentation Engineer, Network Engineer, Mechanical Engineer) from an accredited institution Minimum GPA of 3.0 out of 4.0 or 4.0 out of 5.0 is required Solid academic track record and a genuine interest in pursuing a career aligned with your field of study Strong verbal and written communication skills A growth mindset and a proactive approach to learning and development Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities A team-oriented attitude with the ability to adapt in a dynamic setting Proficiency in English and Arabic language skills are required

3d9097a9cd6da5ae.description: Eram Talent is seeking a Drilling Foreman to join our Unconventional Resources Drilling Department (URDD). Candidate primary role will be to supervise field operations of land Drilling and Workover rigs, engaged in carrying programmed work on deep or otherwise critical wells. Supervises and oversees the operations of a contract rig performing drilling or remedial work on wells ranging from 18,000 - 23,000 feet. Incumbent will ensure that the contractor performs the work in a safe and acceptable manner, and that the contractor meets all the obligations of his contract. Coordinates deliveries of well materials and equipment and ensures it is available when the rig is ready for it. Drilling Rig Foreman administers the contracts on sight and serves as the primary liaison between the company and the contractor. Responsibilities Ensure all rig personnel and service providers are complaining with Saudi Aramco safety standards and requirement. Supervises and oversees all operations performed on wells. Makes recommendations on alternative methods or equipment when unusual situations are encountered. Coordinates deliveries of materials to the well to ensure it is available when required. Ensures that contractor meets all requirements of his contract. Works with Drilling and Workover engineers to see that modern drilling practices are followed. Approves contractor daily tour report. Ensures that contractor rig and equipment are properly maintained to avoid downtime. Performs other miscellaneous duties as directed by Supt. Ensures that Saudi Aramco Blowout Prevention Standards are met in all respects including equipment configuration, testing and crew response. Assures that rig and personnel comply with Saudi Aramco established safety standards and procedures. Minimum of 7 years of experience working in drilling and workover operations including adequate supervisory experience on a drilling or workover rig. Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related field is preferred; Extensive knowledge of drilling equipment, techniques, and safety measures; Strong leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills; Ability to work in high-pressure environments and make quick decisions; Willingness to work in remote locations and harsh weather conditions.

3d73dcbc4c489b4d.description: Müller's Solutions, a distinguished consulting firm specializing in Tech Outsourcing, Managed Services, SAP Implementation & Support, and Global Tech Recruitment, is seeking a skilled Business Analyst to join a significant team currently engaged in the development of an enterprise solution within the public sector. The selected candidate will collaborate with a team of experienced solution architects to enhance their knowledge and competencies in the designated domain. The Business Analyst will be responsible for gathering and documenting business requirements, mapping business processes, performing application testing, conducting end-user training, and troubleshooting issues related to existing applications. Responsibilities Demonstrates professionalism as a representative of AEC, successfully collaborating within a diverse work environment. Engages in cross-functional team meetings aimed at formulating and executing business solutions while enhancing operational efficiency. Performs impact assessments of ERP products and other applications, systems, upgrades, and modifications across functional areas, and evaluates both systems and business processes. Assists in the analysis and redesign of business processes pertaining to the assigned domain(s). Ensures a comprehensive understanding of necessary business functions and processes, documenting these accordingly. Documents requirements specifications for enhancements, upgrades, and remaining legacy functions in accordance with standard templates. Aids in the documentation of requirements and procedures. Coordinates with other application areas to address interdependencies and resolve issues. Oversees post-implementation reviews and monitors business applications within the assigned domain(s). Participates in the Change Request process to authorize, document, test, and validate all modifications to the ERP and other applications. Maintains the confidentiality of information at all times. Shares confidential information acquired during the course of employment only with authorized individuals and with prior approvals as required. Fosters and maintains effective and productive relationships with customers and other team members. EDUCATION: • A Graduate or Post Graduate Degree in Computer Science, Management Information Systems, or an equivalent field from a reputable national or international educational institution. • Certification in either SAP or Oracle is considered an advantage. • Proficiency in both English and Arabic languages is required. RELEVANT EXPERIENCE: • A minimum of 2-3 years of experience in a similar role. • Proven experience in gathering and documenting system requirements as well as detailing system functional design for business application solutions, alongside addressing related implementation issues from a functional standpoint. • Familiarity with enterprise-wide system implementation, integration, interfaces, and data conversion. • Experience with Software Development Life Cycle methodologies. • Experience in the defense sector is considered a plus. SKILLS REQUIREMENTS: • Strong communication skills. • Ability to conduct training sessions. • Understanding and practical experience with technology as an enabler. • Demonstrated capability to work effectively within a diverse team. Why Join Us: Opportunity to work with a talented and passionate team. Competitive salary and benefits package. Exciting projects and innovative work environment.
